components.name: Icon/ThumbUpOutlined (MUI)
components.description:
Positive feedback affordance. Source: @mui/icons-material/ThumbUpOutlined.js (5.15.12), which wraps the MUI Material Symbols path — NOT a Tebra icon. 24 viewBox; SCALE constraints; single path with three subpaths (outer outline, interior counter, cuff). Winding rule set explicitly to NONZERO, which is the SVG default the MUI path is authored against; see the WarningFilled precedent where an import lost fill-rule and the counter filled in.

PRODUCTION NOTE, recorded not resolved: no file imports ThumbUpOutlined. The three feedback surfaces that do this job import the Alt family instead — ThumbUpAltOutlined in facesheet-ui RecommendationsFeedback.tsx:102 and messages-ui SuggestReplyControls.tsx:396, and ThumbUpAlt / ThumbUpOffAlt in clinical-system SummaryFeedback.tsx:1-4. Alt is a visibly different glyph (one unified shape, no separate cuff). If the library is meant to match what ships, this should be ThumbUpAltOutlined.
